notes: Geographic boundaries are Census 2026 legal/administrative district representations. Forecast identity joins do not create candidate votes or vote-share estimates.
Unmatched geography includes holdovers and chambers with no district-model records; no chamber probability is substituted for a missing district forecast.

Floterial districts overlap ordinary districts. They are unions of official Census-listed component districts and must be viewed as a separate layer. Their NH-FLOTERIAL-* identifiers are explicit application namespaces, not fabricated Census GEOIDs.
